description: This Java source file defines the 'UnknownChannelException' class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter to indicate unsupported channels in combination with signals. It includes methods for creating instances, including from JSON, and a builder class for constructing exceptions with specific details.

classes.name: UnknownChannelException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating an unsupported channel in the protocol adapter.
